integrity: Complete derivation, square-zero constraints and rank proof are supplied; a standalone finite checker and explicit limits are included. No independent scientific validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only leaf-involution induced automorphisms on height-one star incidence algebras; finite fields for enumerator, arbitrary fields for structural classification. Computations check finite sample instances only; independent audit not performed. General inner-plus-additive skew-derivation theory and the two-leaf swapped-star cohomology calculation precede this result.
title: Square-zero skew-derivation rank spectra on star incidence algebras
